newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shangri-La Hotel in S$100 mln loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Shangri-La Hotel in S$100 mln loan deal.

text.p: Shangri-La Hotel Ltd said on Monday it had agreed a five year Singapore $100 million transferrable loan facility with an embedded bond call option from the Development Bank of Singapore Ltd.
It said in a statement the deal would refinance its existing five percent S$100 million unsecured bonds, due in 1997.
In return for the loan, DBS would have an option requiring Shangri-La to issue bonds equal to the loan value directly to the bank.
The bonds would not be listed on any stock exchange and would be lodged at authorised depositories in Singapore.

Shangri-La Hotel, which has interests in leisure and retail projects around the region, said it did not expect the loan facility to have any material effect on net tangible assets or earnings per share.
